title: Every owner message in a session's inbox gets a feedback id line within the turn
why: Consultant 22:18 CST Nov 13, relaying runner 10's 22:16 report (triage did not see it): runner 10 skipped the post-compaction audit after its 20:19 compaction; the owner's 20:21 ask ("send to retrospective") carried no inbox id, so nothing tracked it until the owner asked again at 22:14.
source: Consultant 22:18 CST Nov 13 (relayed); second guard for the audit step.
note: Triage 22:18 CST Nov 13: guard idea, not built. Mistake it stops: an owner ask that no record tracks, so nothing follows up. Harm: the owner repeats an ask. Check as the consultant states it: every owner-message heading in a session's inbox gets an fb id line within the turn. Triage read "fb id" as the feedback id the inbox gives a message (unchecked); the lane confirms the form against the inbox code before building. Pairs with step compaction-audit-before-reply, which is the first guard for the same incident (its text names check handoff-audit-ran). Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read before any build.
